decisions.reason: A particle therapy water phantom is a heavy, visible R&D investment in a strategic growth segment, so any slow uptake is easily attributed to the long sales cycles of proton centers.
Small volume chambers are core to the firm's dosimetry heritage and small-field QA, and a new launch with its own page signals ongoing commitment.
Despite some overlap with the other small volume chamber, the sunk development and calibration investment and its fit with the firm's precision-measurement identity favor keeping it.
A multi-model standard clinical chamber line is a backbone product tied to accredited calibration services and is central to the established business.
Relative dosimetry chambers complement the firm's water phantoms and scanning systems, so dropping it would undercut the integrated QA workflow the firm promotes.
Thimble chambers are a staple of clinical dosimetry with long product lifecycles, and the recent public launch makes early withdrawal unlikely.
